caption: The drawing depicts a five-piece tea set, consisting of a lidded sugar bowl, a creamer, a teapot with a lid, a teacup, and a saucer. All pieces are white with rectangular or rounded shapes and feature floral designs in red, blue, and green. Each object has gold or yellow trim along the rims and lids. The floral decorations appear as stylized patterns with green leaves and flowers in blue and red, accented by small blue dots around the upper parts of the teapot, sugar bowl, and creamer. The items are arranged on a plain background within a rectangular border, with the saucer and teacup in the front center, the sugar bowl to the left, the creamer in the center back, and the teapot to the right.
title: Toy China Set
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
